title: 第十九章 二级游戏商店-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》
content:
第(1/3)页

    不过，她的这个计划想要实施就只能等将0级秘境中的所有危险全部排除掉才行，以及她还需要足够多的员工才能够帮自己招呼那些蔬菜水果甚至是猪牛羊这些。

    是的没错，除了各种物资之外，爻雪其实还收集了各种或者的牲畜，只不过因为目前还没有地方养这些家伙，所以此时还封存在系统空间里面。

    等到李磊回去之后，爻雪伸了个懒腰，不过她并没有立刻就去休息，而是对着系统说道，“系统，我记得还有一次免费的店铺升级对吧。”

    【是的宿主，要现在升级吗？】

    “嗯，那就现在升级吧，整个所有人都休息了，没什么人打扰。”

    随着爻雪的一声令下，整个游戏商店都被一层白光所包裹，紧接着，店铺的面积开始增加，楼层数也变成了五层，房间数量变得更多了，最重要的是通电了，而且也有水了。

    不过这个有电有水跟她理解的有电有水似乎有点不一样，算了，这些以后再研究。

    除此电和水之外，空间背包也从一天一个变成了一天两个，同时她现在已经可以制作二级的空间背包了。

    二级空间背包的容量比一级空间背包的容量大一背，一共二十个格子，里面能够叠加的物品数量也从原本的一百变成了二百。

    除此之外，还多出了一个药剂制作室，以及装备制造室，一个是用来制作各种药剂的，一个是用来制作各种装备的。

    一楼的货架数量并没有多，只是多出了一个冷藏区，用餐区也大了不少，还多出了一个厨房，似乎是用来做饭的，只不过里面空空如也，连个厨具都没有，根据系统的尿性，这些东西大概率都是需要她来掏腰包的。

    到了第二天天亮，苏辰一下子就注意到了店里的变化，问道：“店长，你这是升级了？”

    爻雪点了点头：“没错，升级了，从今以后，你们的房间就能通水电了。”

    听到她这样说，包括苏辰在内的所有人脸上都露出了惊喜的神色，太好了，终于能洗澡了。

    “对了，店长你昨天干什么去了，怎么一天都没回来？”惊喜过后，苏辰好奇的问道。

However, for her plan to be implemented, she can only wait until all dangers in the level 0 secret realm are eliminated, and she also needs enough employees to be able to help her with the vegetables, fruits, and even pigs, cattle, and sheep.

Yes, that’s right. In addition to various materials, Yaoxue actually collected various kinds of livestock. However, because there is currently no place to raise these guys, they are still sealed in the system space at this time.

After Li Lei returned, Yaoxue stretched, but she did not go to rest immediately. Instead, she said to the system, "System, I remember there is a free store upgrade, right?"

【Yes host, do you want to upgrade now?】

"Well, let's upgrade now. Everyone has taken a rest and no one will disturb us."

With Yaoxue’s order, the entire game store was enveloped in a layer of white light. Immediately afterwards, the area of the store began to increase, the number of floors became five, the number of rooms became more, and most importantly, there was electricity and water.

But this electricity and water seems a little different from the electricity and water she understands. Forget it, we will study these later.

In addition to electricity and water, the number of space backpacks has also increased from one per day to two per day. At the same time, she can now make a second-level space backpack.

The capacity of the second-level space backpack is larger than that of the first-level space backpack, with a total of twenty grids, and the number of items that can be stacked in it has also changed from the original one hundred to two hundred.

In addition, there is also a potion making room and an equipment manufacturing room, one is used to make various potions, and the other is used to make various equipment.

There are not many shelves on the first floor, but there is an extra refrigeration area, the dining area is also much larger, and there is an extra kitchen, which seems to be used for cooking, but it is empty, not even a kitchen utensil. According to the urine of the system, she will most likely need to pay for these things.

At dawn the next day, Su Chen immediately noticed the changes in the store and asked: "Store manager, have you upgraded?"

Yaoxue nodded: "Yes, it has been upgraded. From now on, your room will have water and electricity."

Hearing her say this, everyone including Su Chen had a look of surprise on their faces. It was great, I could finally take a shower.

"By the way, store manager, what did you do yesterday? Why didn't you come back all day?" After the surprise, Su Chen asked curiously.
